## Overview

Repeats a preset or keyframes — endlessly or a set number of times, restarting or reversing each
cycle.

Stable API — covered by semantic-versioning guarantees.

- **Kind:** Directive
- **Stability:** `stable`

## Selector

```text
[moveLoop]
```
